text: The customer's dinner at the neighborhood bistro was a catastrophe. The "Pan-Seared Salmon" was a dry, flavorless slab of fish that had clearly been overcooked, with a rubbery texture that was off-putting to the touch. The accompanying "Roasted Vegetables" were a sad, limp mess, with the once-crisp carrots now resembling soggy twigs that had been drenched in a cloying, sweet sauce that had an unpleasantly sticky consistency. The "Garlic Mashed Potatoes" were a particular travesty, with a pungent aroma that was overwhelming, but failed to translate to any actual flavor in the mouth, where instead the customer found a bland, gluey texture that coated the tongue and the roof of the mouth. Overall, the dish was a mess of a meal that left the customer feeling disappointed and, quite frankly, a little queasy.
